record.field: # Tooling Components theme setup (import-safe). Re-run on every install/upgrade. # Only ever touches the Tooling Components website. PALETTE_URL = '/website/static/src/scss/options/colors/user_color_palette.scss' PALETTE_SCSS = """ $o-user-color-palette: map-merge($o-user-color-palette, o-map-omit(( 'o-color-1': #1A1A24, 'o-color-2': #E65F2B, 'o-color-3': #D5CABD, 'o-color-4': #FFFFFF, 'o-color-5': #1A1A24, 'o-cc1-btn-primary': 'o-color-2', 'o-cc1-btn-primary-border': 'o-color-2', 'o-cc1-link': 'o-color-1', // -- hook -- ))); """ MENU = [('Products', '/shop', 10), ('Solutions', '/solutions', 20), ('Technical Resources', '/blog', 30), ('About', '/about-us', 40), ('Contact', '/contactus', 50)] PAGES = [('/', 'tooling_components_theme.tc_home', 'Home'), ('/about-us', 'tooling_components_theme.tc_about', 'About Tooling Components'), ('/contactus', 'tooling_components_theme.tc_contact', 'Contact Tooling Components'), ('/quote', 'tooling_components_theme.tc_quote', 'Request a Quote'), ('/solutions', 'tooling_components_theme.tc_solutions', 'Solutions')] OPTIONS = [('website_sale.products_list_view', True), ('website_sale.products_categories', True), ('website_sale.products_attributes', True), ('website_blog.opt_blog_cover_post', False), ('website_blog.opt_blog_post_regular_cover', False), ('website_blog.opt_blog_post_breadcrumb', False), ('website_blog.opt_blog_post_read_next', False), ('website_blog.opt_blog_post_readable', False), ('website_sale.product_custom_text', False), ('website_sale.product_picture_magnify_hover', False), ('website_sale.product_picture_magnify_click', False)] Website = env['website'].sudo() targets = Website.search([('x_tc_theme_active', '=', True)]) or Website.search([('name', '=ilike', 'Tooling Components%')], limit=1) View = env['ir.ui.view'].sudo() Page = env['website.page'].sudo() ICP = env['ir.config_parameter'].sudo() for website in targets: website.write({'x_tc_theme_active': True}) if not website.x_tc_quote_form_url: website.write({'x_tc_quote_form_url': 'https://api.leadconnectorhq.com/widget/form/uMz8uscuFB4ptYTVuP3h'}) # Dale 25 Sep: "Industries" is really "Solutions" for menu in env['website.menu'].sudo().search([('website_id', '=', website.id), ('url', 'in', ['/#solutions', '/#industries'])]): menu.write({'name': 'Solutions', 'url': '/solutions'}) for menu in env['website.menu'].sudo().search([('website_id', '=', website.id), ('name', '=', 'Industries')]): menu.write({'name': 'Solutions', 'url': '/solutions'}) for menu in env['website.menu'].sudo().search([('website_id', '=', website.id), ('name', 'in', ['Blog', 'Knowledge'])]): menu.write({'name': 'Technical Resources', 'url': '/blog'}) if not env['product.tag'].sudo().search([('name', '=', 'Request Quote')], limit=1): env['product.tag'].sudo().create({'name': 'Request Quote'}) # menu: only the first time (never overwrite builder edits) key = 'tooling_components_theme.menu_done.%s' % website.id if not ICP.get_param(key) and website.menu_id: Menu = env['website.menu'].sudo() Menu.search([('parent_id', '=', website.menu_id.id), ('website_id', '=', website.id)]).unlink() for name, url, seq in MENU: Menu.create({'name': name, 'url': url, 'sequence': seq, 'parent_id': website.menu_id.id, 'website_id': website.id}) ICP.set_param(key, '1') # pages: website-specific wrapper view t-calling the shared template for url, view_key, name in PAGES: template = env.ref(view_key) if template.website_id: template.write({'website_id': False}) wrapper_key = '%s_page_w%s' % (view_key, website.id) wrapper = View.search([('key', '=', wrapper_key), ('website_id', '=', website.id)], limit=1) if not wrapper: wrapper = View.create({'name': name, 'type': 'qweb', 'key': wrapper_key, 'website_id': website.id, 'arch': '<t t-name="%s"><t t-call="%s"/></t>' % (wrapper_key, view_key)}) page = Page.search([('url', '=', url), ('website_id', '=', website.id)], limit=1) if not page: page = Page.search([('url', '=', url), ('view_id', '=', template.id)], limit=1) if page: if page.view_id != wrapper: page.write({'view_id': wrapper.id}) else: Page.create({'url': url, 'view_id': wrapper.id, 'name': name, 'is_published': True, 'website_indexed': True}) # shop / blog options (copy-on-write for this website only) site = website.with_context(website_id=website.id) for view_key, active in OPTIONS: view = site.viewref(view_key, raise_if_not_found=False) if view and view.active != active: view.with_context(website_id=website.id).write({'active': active}) # brand palette (attachment + ir.asset replace, through Odoo's own API) custom_url = '/_custom/web.assets_frontend' + PALETTE_URL if not env['ir.asset'].sudo().search([('path', '=', custom_url), ('website_id', '=', website.id)], limit=1): env['ir.attachment'].sudo().search([('url', '=', custom_url), ('website_id', '=', website.id)]).unlink() env['web_editor.assets'].with_context(website_id=website.id).save_asset(PALETTE_URL, 'web.assets_frontend', PALETTE_SCSS, 'scss')
